title: The participatory zero is measurable readiness, not absence

statements.text: Kolesnikov defines the participatory zero $\mathcal{P}_0$ as an integral of an activation function, a participatory potential and the gradient of a structure, over the region near threshold: a phase-integrated volume of readiness that precedes activation, so that withheld interaction is measurable.

sources.quote: this model defines it as a phase-integrated volume of readiness that precedes activation
